headline: Advancements in Quantum Dynamics and Non-Hermitian Physics
summary: Today's research explores advanced computational methods and fundamental limits in quantum mechanics and statistical physics. Papers span from GPU-accelerated molecular dynamics and non-Hermitian lattice universalities to quantum information engines and variational limits for fermions.

themes.title: Quantum Systems and Open Dynamics
themes.body: Investigations into open quantum systems, non-additive master equations, and parity-time symmetric dimers. Researchers analyze measurement feedback, work statistics, noise-induced escape, and the breakdown or recovery of stability through tailored dissipation.

themes.title: Simulation and Foundational Quantum Mechanics
themes.body: New computational strategies and mathematical proofs addressing scaling limits in quantum physics. This includes GPU-implemented mixed quantum-classical molecular dynamics, universal bulk density of states in non-Hermitian lattices, and variational completeness for continuum fermions.

connections.body: Both studies explore non-Hermitian phenomena or non-standard system descriptions, addressing how boundary conditions, spectral properties, and nonlinearities alter long-time behaviors in lattices and dimers.
